title_zh: 辛亥革命与清朝的终结
title_en: Chinese History (12/20): The Xinhai Revolution and the End of the Qing
note_en: 既 A 又 B means "both A and B" and links two qualities or actions that are true at the same time: 气氛既紧张又充满期待 "the mood was both tense and full of hope." English can just say "tense and hopeful," but Chinese marks both halves: 既 before the first and 又 before the second, and the two parts usually share a subject and are roughly balanced in length.
